title: Essay Passage: Community
titleMy: စာစီစာကုံး: လူ့အဖွဲ့အစည်း
description: Type a longer essay passage about community.

exercises.instruction: A community is a group of people who help and support one another. When someone is sick, the neighbors offer food and care. When it rains, they share umbrellas. A strong community makes life safer, warmer, and more joyful for every person who belongs to it.
